name: Development, Stem Cells and Regenerative Medicine PhD

deadlines.label: Final application deadline
deadlines.note: Timeline on the page explicitly advertising Summer 2027, starting July 1, 2027.

applicationFee.note: International $70; domestic $65. Automatic waiver only for current or former US armed-forces service; overseas applicants must confirm qualification.

english.note: PTE 54 also accepted. Central exemption requests can require proof the entire university teaches exclusively in English; see source policy.

documents: After accepting enrollment: foreign bachelor’s degree requires a general/document-by-document NACES evaluation sent directly by the evaluator before the first term; US bachelor’s degrees exempt
requirements.note: Formerly Molecular and Developmental Biology. Accredited bachelor or equivalent, GPA at least 3.2, strong biology/biochemistry; prior research preferred. Statement covers preparation, research, goals and fit. Applications open September 1, 2026; interviews December–January in Cincinnati with travel covered. Lab rotations precede research-advisor selection.

funding.note: Guaranteed stipend, tuition and health coverage. Published 2026–27 rates: $40,315 before qualifying, $42,315 afterward; these are not a confirmed Summer 2027 rate. Relocation reimbursement up to $1,000.
